meta.title: Add autovacuum optimization CLI
meta.body_summary: Adds an 'autovac' CLI command to apply or rollback optimized autovacuum settings for PGQueuer tables, with SQL builder, async execution, tests and documentation.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex added autovacuum CLI wrapping SQL builders; merged after copilot nitpick without performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 225 changed lines across 8 files, this is a small-to-medium feature addition by absolute volume. It fits a focused CLI enhancement and was merged without blocking review.

review_details.concern_detail: Copilot bot suggested renaming inner function 'run' to 'execute_autovacuum' for clarity, but no follow-up action was taken.
review_details.performance_claim: Add CLI to apply optimized autovacuum settings for PGQueuer tables, reducing manual tuning effort.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Simple CLI addition wrapping SQL builders; no complex performance or cross-service changes; merged without friction.

detection_detail.code_reading: Copilot bot performed a code review and suggested a minor readability improvement.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance benchmarks or before/after metrics included; the optimization claim is implicit.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regressions or blocking issues; PR merged without fix cycle.

core_change_summary.description: Adds a new 'autovac' CLI command that generates and optionally applies SQL to optimize autovacuum settings for PGQueuer tables, with rollback support. Introduces SQL builder functions in qb.py and an async executor in queries.py; includes test and documentation.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: CI workflow and docker-compose were tuned to support the new feature.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: refactor autovacuum builder, add CLI command, test, and docs.
Subsequent commits: add documentation for autovac and durability, fix doc command names, inline query picker, tune CI autovac settings, add schedules/statistics table to SQL builders.
Final commit: minor tweaks to CI, docker-compose, and queries.

review_signals.summary: PR overview with no blocking comments; reviewed 5 out of 5 files.
Suggested renaming inner function 'run' to 'execute_autovacuum' for clarity.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with initial refactor commit, tests, and documentation.
Copilot bot submitted an overview review with a nitpick inline comment.
Multiple follow-up commits added documentation fixes, CI tuning, and final tweaks.
Maintainer enabled auto-squash and merged after ~86 hours without human review interaction.
